text:
anya: infra-bot just fired an alert — persistent throughput drop in us-west-2 pool-7 (~30%) and ~5 worker restarts across hosts
infra-bot: [ALERT] throughput: -32% over 5m, worker restarts x5, recent OOM traces on GPU0-GPU2
sam: seeing repeated GPU OOMs and lots of page reclaim churn on those nodes. likely mem-frag + small-batch spikes
ben: pinned down a pattern: kernel selector recently flipped to fastpath-int8 for models with long KV prefixes. when prefix cache hits drop, we get sudden KV evicts and allocator thrash
kai: I pulled a perf profile from one affected worker. rough paste below:
```
-- profile dump --
time: 00:02:30
kernel_choice: fastpath_int8 (60%) -> fallback_fp16 (40%)
kv_cache_evictions/sec: 340
alloc/sweep_calls: 1200
gpu_free_pages: 1.8GB -> 1.1GB over 2m
worker_restarts: 3 in 120s
```
lucy: that matches our infra metrics: prefetch queue depth collapsed and batching stalled. small requests started forcing immediate allocations instead of reusing KV pages
anya: any recent deploys touching kernel heuristics or prefetch thresholds?
sam: rolled kernel-selector heuristic in last night (rev r1253). also bumped prefetch target from 8->24 to be optimistic about throughput
ben: suspect combo: aggressive prefetch + int8 fastpath -> increased transient allocation pressure for KV pages, then eviction loop, then OOMs and restarts
kai: quick mitigations I can try now: revert prefetch bump, pin kernel selector to stable fallback, and raise allocator reserve pages on the affected hosts
lucy: +1 to reverting prefetch. we should avoid full node restarts if possible
anya: do it in this order: 1) pin selector -> reduces kernel thrash, 2) revert prefetch -> reduces new allocation sweep, 3) increase slab reserve -> gives breathing room for KV cache while we stabilize
sam: applying kernel pin on pool-7 now (hotfix): `kubectl set env ds/runtime KERNEL_SELECTOR=stable-fallback --selector=pool=pool-7`
infra-bot: deploy started: runtime ds update pool-7 (stage=hotfix)
(2m later)
ben: kernel pin rolled, early signs: per-node kernel_choice stabilized to fallback_fp16 ~85% and eviction rate halved
kai: reverting prefetch next. issuing rollback for prefetch config (target=8)
lucy: also bumping allocator reserve: `runtimectl set --node node-7 --allocator-reserve=1g` on the three nodes with highest churn
anya: monitoring. if no improvement in 10m we consider controlled rolling restarts to reclaim fragmented pages
(7m later)
sam: after actions: throughput recovered ~18% and OOMs stopped; worker restarts have fallen to 0 in the last 5m
ben: logs show KV eviction rate back to baseline and sweep calls dropped by ~70% in profiles. likely root cause: prefetch bump + kernel-selector mispredict on long-prefix traffic patterns
kai: follow-ups: add a safety gate to kernel selector (don't choose fastpath_int8 if avg_prefix_len>X) and better monitor for prefetch-induced allocation spikes
lucy: also add an alert for sustained KV eviction rate > 200/s; that would have warned earlier
anya: I'll open a postmortem stub and assign owners for follow-ups. good triage work everyone :thumbsup:
infra-bot: incident stamped: INCIDENT-2024-171862 — throughput drop (prefetch+kernel mismatch)
anya: putting a short RCA timeline in #incidents-docs later today. we can close this thread once owners ack the action items
ben: acked. I'll own the kernel selector safety gate PR
kai: I'll own the allocator-config changes and the new eviction alert
lucy: I'll add the postmortem notes and link the perf dumps
sam: thanks — keep monitoring for any regressions
anya: closing monitoring window for now, leave thread open for updates
